pr_title: Shows menu when dragging connection on empty space in visual shader
pr_body:
Showing the member menu (and connect to first port after accept) when dragging connection from input/output ports seems like a good idea (and often requested)

![ct](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/3036176/60245019-58a91a00-98c4-11e9-8c06-b45b09d804a5.gif)

This PR changes GraphEdit a bit by adding new signal and allow to call it when user dragging connection from input ports

Fix #30085 in Godot 3.2

I noticed that only input (Left) pins don't have such behaviour (Left "arrow"-like pins too)

Right-side pins work as expected

review_comments: Is this still a "release_position" in this case, or would it be the "start_position"?
Well, it will be valid in both cases because user releases the mouse in both cases. If I rename it to "start_position" then by same logic "connection_to_empty" should have "end_position" ?

I mean, does this variable give the position of the mouse release in both cases? If so, its name is correct, but it doesn't really seem useful in the `from_empty` method? One would likely know where the "empty" start position was, and not where the mouse was released on a slot.

Hmm.. yes, the release_position can be used in both cases. They are similar to each other - the difference is just the direction of ports (input or output).

 In the case of visual shader editor there is already a call from `_show_members_dialog` by `Input::get_singleton()->get_mouse_position()` so its not used directly.
